title: PAR-14 wide DWG writer bit-count accounting
mode: Bounded source arithmetic audit and generated writer fast slice
scope: Classify the remaining non-pointer multiplication expressions in the selected shared DWG reader/buffer files.
Fix the adjacent internal writer bit-count truncation without changing the DWG wire representation.
Test arithmetic boundaries without allocating a 512 MiB buffer and run only the owning fast writer/object tests.
localEvidence: src/intern/dwgbuffer.cpp::getUModularChar and getModularChar consume at most five 7-bit groups; their largest magnitude is bounded below 2^35.
src/intern/dwgbuffer.cpp::getModularShort consumes at most two 15-bit words; the largest shift count is 15.
src/intern/dwgreader.cpp::readDwgEed widens the uint16 UTF-16 code-unit count before multiplying by two and checks the product against the bounded chunk before allocating.
src/intern/dwgreader.cpp staging-capacity products use quotient prechecks or counts constrained by existing resource caps.
src/intern/dwgbufferw.cpp::dwgBufferW::bitCount previously cast byte size to uint32_t before multiplying by eight; at 2^29 bytes it returned zero although the exact count is 2^32 bits.
src/intern/dwgsafety.h general MaxBufferSize is 0x2f000000 bytes, greater than the 2^29-byte bit-count wrap boundary.
DWG writer header handseed offsets and legacy object bit-size fields remain 32-bit wire fields and require explicit checked narrowing.

assessment.existingPlanOwner: PAR-14 arithmetic and cursor-bound audit; adjacent writer bit-count accounting

behavior: Add a checked buffer-size/partial-byte cursor to total-bit helper using 64-bit multiply/add.
Return uint64_t from dwgBufferW::bitCount and widen bit-copy iteration accordingly.
Check header handseed and legacy object bit counts before writing them to existing 32-bit fields.
Validate patchRawBytesAtBit ranges against the checked full bit count and platform indexing width.
Add integer-only boundaries for the 2^32-bit transition, largest partial-byte u32 count, invalid cursor states, multiplication overflow, and ordinary writer output.

validation.build: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_writer_primitives_tests --parallel 2 — passed; cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dwg_object_vectors_tests libdxfrw_dwg_local_roundtrip --parallel 2 — passed
validation.diffCheck: Scoped git diff --check for changed source and test files — passed

planChanges: Record and fix the writer-side 32-bit bitCount truncation while preserving all existing serialized 32-bit field limits.
Classify the reviewed parser multiplication sites as fixed-iteration-bounded, budget-prechecked, or already capped; do not add redundant parser tests for proven bounds.
Self-unblock to the direct object-body bit-position multiplication sites in src/drw_objects.cpp for the next PAR-14 audit slice.
limitations: The exact 512 MiB storage vector was not allocated; the arithmetic helper was tested at that boundary directly.
The source audit was bounded to the named shared reader/buffer paths and does not close all project-wide arithmetic review.
No full suite, peer implementation, native CAD application, or ACIS kernel was run.
No external drawing fixture was downloaded or added.
